messages:
Devon: heads up — after yesterday's TP + fused-attn roll we see a 20-35% tail-latency increase on 8xA100 runs for long-context workloads. not obvious from unit tests.
Anya: can you paste the perf numbers and which config? model / seq_len / microbatch?
Devon: model=redwood-xxl, seq_len=4096, tp=4, pp=1, microbatch=4 -> p99 token latency up ~30ms (was ~95ms, now ~125ms). throughput similar.
Mike: ran a quick nvprof / Nsight trace. big stalls on a single CUDA stream during NCCL all-gather of QKV shards. looks like all-gather happens at every layer start when kv cache is remapped. snippet:```
Stream 2: stall 142ms @ ncclAllReduce (bytes=3.2MB)
Stream 1: compute 8ms -> wait 140ms -> compute resumes
```
Julia: hmm — that suggests comm/compute overlap not working. did the fused-attn kernel force a sync or use default stream? any cudaGraph capture differences?
Devon: fused kernel uses its own streams for flash-attn, but the QKV all-gather uses the default comm stream. suspect we accidentally created a dependency: kernel writes to KV tensor in streamA, then nccl launched on streamB without proper event, so it waits.
Anya: also check KV cache layout: we recently changed shard layout to interleaved offsets to reduce memory, maybe that causes extra indexing + padding so all-gather needs heavyweight memcpy.
Mike: profiling shows extra memcopies: host->device copies around the nccl call when seq_len>2048. nvtx markers show memcpy(2) before nccl.
Julia: proposal: 1) try marking the all-gather on the same stream as the kernel (or ensure event-based async launch), 2) add prefetch stage to local GPU for KV shards before sched, 3) try hierarchical allreduce (intra-node reduce then inter-node) to reduce latency for our small-ish messages.
Devon: +1. also want to try fallback: for head_dim not  divisible by 32, our padded fused path causes an extra reorder. for those cases prefer non-fused QKV path. That might be a quick toggle in kernel selector.
Mike: I can run an experiment: (A) bind nccl to compute stream, (B) force non-fused path when head_dim%32!=0, (C) stagger microbatch launch across TP ranks by 1 step to smooth nccl peaks. will post traces.
infra-bot: started perf-job pipeline/infra/prof-1760901234 on cluster-a (job id perf-176090-3).
Anya: also check NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING and NCCL_ALGO to see if algorithm switching changed behavior after driver update. driver was bumped last week.
Devon: noted. timeline: Mike tests A/B today, Julia will prototype event-based sync helpers in runtime, I'll add kernel-selector flag to revert fused path per-head-dim. if all good we can hotfix rollout to 8x configs.
Mike: quick raw result from test A (nccl on compute stream): p99 improved ~18ms, no extra memcpys, but small increase in GPU SM utilization — looks promising.
Julia: great. we should also add an automated perf check that runs seq_len 4096 + tp=4 on PRs that touch attention or kv layout. catch regressions earlier.
Devon: agreed. next steps: Mike will run extended run overnight and upload traces; Julia adds small PR for stream/event helpers; Anya will add perf CI job. thanks folks :white_check_mark:
__notes: This document is a synthetic Slack thread about fused-attn + TP communication stalls, profiling, and mitigation steps. All fields are strings or list of strings as required.
